pins.name: 3V3
pins.connect: 3.0-3.6 V, supply able to give 0.5 A

pins.name: IO2
pins.connect: GPIO2, FSPIQ = SPI slave MISO (ESP-Hosted default)

pins.name: EN
pins.connect: high = on, low = off; never floating; RC 10k/1u

pins.name: IO4
pins.connect: GPIO4 MTMS (strap: SDIO edge) : ESP-Hosted SPI Data Ready (default); ESP-AT UART1 RTS

pins.name: IO5
pins.connect: GPIO5 MTDI (strap: SDIO edge): ESP-AT UART1 CTS

pins.name: IO6
pins.connect: GPIO6 FSPICLK = SPI slave clock (ESP-Hosted default); ESP-AT UART1 RX

pins.name: IO7
pins.connect: GPIO7 FSPID = SPI slave MOSI (ESP-Hosted default); ESP-AT UART1 TX

pins.name: IO15
pins.connect: GPIO15 strap (JTAG source; ignored with default eFuses; no internal pull)

pins.name: IO8
pins.connect: GPIO8 strap: must be 1 for download mode; ROM print control

pins.name: IO9
pins.connect: GPIO9 strap: 1 = normal boot (weak internal pull-up), 0 = download

pins.name: IO20
pins.connect: SDIO_DATA0; ESP-AT SPI MISO default; ESP-Hosted UART RX default

pins.name: IO21
pins.connect: SDIO_DATA1; ESP-AT SPI handshake default; ESP-Hosted UART TX default

circuit.value: internal weak pull-up; add 10k pull-up + test pad/expander line to pull low for download
pull-up 10k (must be high in download mode; do not hold low at reset)
test pads on TXD0, RXD0, EN, IO9 (or USB D-/D+ on IO12/IO13)
circuit.source: ESP32-C6-MINI-1/1U datasheet v1.5 p13 (joint download: USB-Serial-JTAG, UART, SDIO)

supplies.tx_peak: 382 mA 802.11b 20.5 dBm; 316 mA 11g; 295 mA 11n HT20; 251 mA 11ax; BLE 309 mA at 19 dBm; 802.15.4 305 mA at 19 dBm (EDS p27)

logic.can_run_1V8: no: module I/O is on the 3.3 V supply
logic.EN: reset when below 0.25 x VDD for >= 50 us; rails stable >= 50 us before EN rises (EDS p15-16, p27)
logic.strap_defaults: MTMS, MTDI, GPIO8, GPIO15 floating; GPIO9 weak pull-up (EDS p12)

esp-hosted-mcu (github.com/espressif/esp.supported_on_C6: SDIO, SPI full-duplex, SPI half-duplex, UART (support table in docs/getting-started-mcu.md)
esp-hosted-mcu (github.com/espressif/esp.spi_full_duplex_default_pins_C6: CLK GPIO6, MOSI GPIO7, MISO GPIO2, CS GPIO10, Handshake GPIO3, Data Ready GPIO4, reset = EN (docs/getting-started-mcu.md section 2.1; coprocessor/eh_cp_transport/Kconfig.cp.spi). GPIO10 is NOT brought out on the MINI-1 module: CS must be re-assigned in menuconfig (any free GPIO).
esp-hosted-mcu (github.com/espressif/esp.spi_details: slave SPI mode 3 on C6 (Kconfig default); every transaction is a fixed 1600-byte full-duplex frame; Handshake and Data Ready are mandatory host interrupts; reset line to EN mandatory; start at 5-10 MHz
esp-hosted-mcu (github.com/espressif/esp.sdio_pins_C6: fixed: CLK GPIO19, CMD GPIO18, D0 GPIO20, D1 GPIO21, D2 GPIO22, D3 GPIO23, reset EN; 51k pull-ups mandatory; up to 50 MHz
esp-hosted-mcu (github.com/espressif/esp.uart_default_pins_C6: TX GPIO21, RX GPIO20, start 115200 baud; lowest throughput (not for > 1 Mbit/s)
esp-hosted-mcu (github.com/espressif/esp.spi_half_duplex_C6: CLK 6, D0 7, D1 2, CS 10, Data Ready 11, D2 5, D3 4 (GPIO10/11 not on the module: re-assign)

firmware_transports.esp-hosted Linux variants (esp-hosted-li: for Linux hosts (cfg80211 kernel driver); not applicable to the RT1176 running its own OS. Old esp_hosted_ng/fg doc paths now 404; repository README points to esp-hosted-linux and esp-hosted-mcu

esp-at (github.com/espressif/esp-at, mas.uart_default: UART1: GPIO6 RX, GPIO7 TX, GPIO5 CTS, GPIO4 RTS, 115200 baud; UART0 GPIO17 RX / GPIO16 TX for download and log (docs/en/Get_Started/Hardware_connection.rst, C6 4MB series incl. MINI)
esp-at (github.com/espressif/esp-at, mas.spi_at: needs a rebuild; C6 defaults SCLK GPIO19, MISO GPIO20, MOSI GPIO18, CS GPIO23, HANDSHAKE GPIO21 (How_to_implement_SPI_AT.rst); half-duplex slave; one handshake interrupt line
esp-at (github.com/espressif/esp-at, mas.sdio_at: needs a rebuild; same fixed SDIO pins GPIO18-23 (How_to_implement_SDIO_AT.rst)

to_brain: Handshake (interrupt input) - NOT in pin plan
Data Ready (interrupt input) - NOT in pin plan (ESP-Hosted only)

antenna.MINI-1: on-board PCB antenna; no external parts; Wi-Fi/BLE/802.15.4 share it internally (EDS p3)
antenna.MINI-1U: U.FL-type connector, 50 ohm external antenna; no keep-out needed (EDS p10)
antenna.placement: antenna overhanging the board edge with the feed point nearest the edge; if it cannot overhang, cut away or keep copper-free the board under and on both sides of the antenna and do not put the module mid-board (Espressif hardware design guidelines, PCB layout page). Clearance figure is an image: about 15 mm each side [mem]

notes: Pin plan gives the C6 one chip select on the shared radio SPI. Both SPI firmwares need at least one more direct interrupt line (ESP-AT: handshake; ESP-Hosted: handshake + data ready) plus EN. The pin list shows no free pad except STBY_REQ.

Shared bus: ESP-Hosted clocks 1600 bytes per transaction (1.3 ms at 10 MHz) in SPI mode 3 while the other radios use mode 0 and short frames; possible with per-device settings but it blocks CC1101/LR1121/Si24R1 register access meanwhile. Whether the C6 releases MISO when its CS is high was not confirmed.
Default ESP-Hosted CS (GPIO10) and SPI-HD Data Ready (GPIO11) do not exist on this module.
IO4/IO5 are SDIO-edge straps and IO8/IO9/IO15 boot straps: the host must not drive IO9 low or IO8 low during reset. Data Ready on IO4 idles low, harmless unless SDIO is used.
JLCPCB datasheet copy for C5736265 is the Chinese v0.6 pre-release; the English v1.5 from espressif.com was used.
